title: Two Smiling Young Women Outdoors, 1940s Elko Border Snapshot Photo
description: A charming World War II-era snapshot capturing two smiling young women standing arm-in-arm outdoors. The woman on the left wears a white summery knee-length dress, while the woman on the right sports 1940s bobby soxer fashion—a button-down collared blouse, floral print skirt, and white ankle socks. A bicycle is parked by a fence in the background, and a bright photographic light leak or lens flare streaks across the left subject. The photo is enclosed in a distinctive decorative ELKO photofinishing border.
